newsitem.title: CHINA: Mobil to invest in China LPG wharf.
newsitem.headline: Mobil to invest in China LPG wharf.

text.p: Mobil Corp will invest $89.4 million to build a wharf and facilities for storing liquified petroleum gas (LPG) at Zhuhai in China's southern province of Guangdong, the China News Service said on Monday.

Mobil will build storage facilities with a capacity of 80,000 tonnes of LPG and an underground warehouse with the ability to store 200,000 cubic metres of LPG, the news agency quoted a Mobil official as saying.

A Mobil subsidiary in Zhuhai had acquired a 50-year lease on 300,000 square metres of land at Zhuhai port, site of the planned storage facilities, the official said. He did not say how much Mobil paid for the land rights.
Zhuhai officials declined comment on the deal.
Mobil has set up three wholly-owned subsidiaries in booming Zhuhai, one of China's five special economic zones, the agency said.
The project was expected to go into operation in 1999 and would be one of Mobil's largest investments in China, it said.
